nameservers.sh: a dry run. These are the calls --apply makes; nothing is sent.

the zone's pair, from Cloudflare
  GET /zones?name=omarchy-mac.org
the registrar's set, from Porkbun
  POST https://api.porkbun.com/api/json/v3/domain/listAll {}
  POST https://api.porkbun.com/api/json/v3/dns/getDnssecRecords/omarchy-mac.org {}
  POST https://api.porkbun.com/api/json/v3/domain/getNs/omarchy-mac.org {}
  POST https://api.porkbun.com/api/json/v3/domain/updateNs/omarchy-mac.org {"ns":[<the zone's pair>]}
